caption: The drawing features a large, central depiction of a dark-colored cauldron with a rounded body and a wide opening, shown in a front elevation view. Attached to the cauldron is a thick, arched metal handle, which rises above the pot and has a looped shape at its apex; the handle is fastened to the vessel at two points near the rim. Below the main illustration, there are two smaller, square-framed drawings: the one on the left shows a top-down view of the cauldron with the handle visible across the opening, while the one on the right provides a close-up detail of the attachment point where the handle meets the rim, highlighting the metal loops that secure the handle. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray and black on a lightly yellowed background, using shaded pencil or charcoal, and is enclosed within a double-lined rectangular border. In the bottom right corner, the name "Francis Law Durand" is inscribed.
title: Fireplace Pot
